Rashi on Shabbat 4a:2:1.hebrew: לכי תיכול עלה כורא דמילחא - בבדיחותא אהדר ליה: כשתמדוד לי כור של מלח, אומר לך טעמו של דבר. לישנא אחרינא: לכשתאכל עליה כור של מלח, לא תוכל להשוותם זו לזו:
Rashi on Shabbat 4a:2:1.english: When you eat a kor of salt over it - He answered him in jest: When you measure out a kor of salt for me, I will tell you the reason for the matter. Another explanation: [Even] when you eat a kor of salt over it, you will not be able to equate them to one another.

Tosafot on Shabbat 4a:1:1.hebrew: כאן לחצר אחרת - ואסור להחזירה דקתני, לא להחזירה אצלו קאמר, אלא להחזירה לחצר אחרת:
Tosafot on Shabbat 4a:1:1.english: Here, to a different courtyard - And as for that which it teaches, "it is prohibited to bring it back" — it does not mean bringing it back to himself [i.e., to his own courtyard], but rather bringing it into a different courtyard.
